name: Utkarsh Giri
bio: I'm a postdoctoral fellow at Caltech, working on cosmological surveys and statistical methods for extracting signals from large-scale astrophysical datasets. On the side, I like tinkering with machine learning.

details: Working on data analysis and inference pipelines for the SPHEREx satellite mission.
Developing methods to extract cosmological signals from noisy, high-dimensional survey data.
Developed a neural network-enhanced estimator for primordial non-Gaussianity.
Built simulation-to-inference pipelines using N-body simulations and halo-model analytics.
Contributed to Bayesian analysis of fast radio burst signals as part of the CHIME/FRB Collaboration.
Thesis: Reconstructing Cosmic Velocities with the Kinetic Sunyaev-Zeldovich Effect

education.institution: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Pune
details: Thesis: Lepton Flavour Violation in Supersymmetry
Advisors: Rohini Godbole and Sudhir Vempati
